主要内容: On February 6, 2015, Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. increased its Board of Directors from seven to eight members and elected James H. Williams as a new Class III director. Mr. Williams will receive standard director fees, including $25,000 annually (pro-rated to $22,917 for 2015) and $1,000 per in-person Board meeting ($500 for telephonic attendance). He will also be eligible for equity-based awards under the Company’s 2005 Director Equity Incentive Plan. If he remains a director until the Grant Date (the earlier of the release of Q4 2014 earnings or the filing of the 10-K), he will receive an option to purchase 9,166 shares of common stock at the fair market value on the Grant Date, calculated as the average of the high and low NYSE MKT prices. The Company also plans to enter into a director indemnification agreement with Mr. Williams effective February 6, 2015.
